properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 6 PR 5), items of req:small-read-back-faults-from-the-cogito-trial-are-fixed: 1 a stated foundation is never listed unsupported; 2/9 a generated step name follows its premises, added or deleted; 3 a statement's `source` text draws a `source_note` (it counts only through a documenting Artifact); 4 answer_question `also_records` links one answer from every record it became; 5/7 reasoning_report spends the budget the claims leave and names the caller's budget, never "a budget of 0"; 6 withdraw_question takes a question's own `question_id`, and refuses an unknown one naming those that exist; 10 loop_status.session says `counted: false` on a server that has seen no call before this one; 11 a computed check with a pinned `.calc.json` is an executable form and a run fed back; 13 get_node's `foundations_and_proof` says why every foundation holds while no derivation does; 14 a blast radius from a check never crosses a GOVERNED_BY after climbing VERIFIES; 15 a settled decision's own "PROPOSED…, awaiting the owner" is caught by settled_question_prose. And phase 4's hub fault: a node NAME equal to its id is not prefixed in a routed reply.
properties.name: The trials' small read-back and write faults are fixed: foundations, step names, sources, answers, budgets, questions, session counts, kept records, proof notes, check walks, settled text and hub names
